description: This file defines the 'ShippingMethod' class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Checkout' namespace. It provides a method to retrieve available shipping methods based on the shipping address, loading extensions dynamically and sorting them by sort order.

classes.name: ShippingMethod
classes.description: Represents the shipping method model that retrieves available shipping options based on a shipping address.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available shipping methods based on the provided shipping address by loading extensions, checking their status, and invoking their quote methods. It returns the shipping options sorted by their sort order.
